label: WA

notes.grounding: Claims about the script match it: options -v/-j/-f/-q/-h, Overall Completion vs Completion in --file mode, exit 0 always on success and 1 on errors, trailing exit-code comment block, globals block with SINGLE_FILE, section 8 arg loop, bc preflight, Bash 3.2 target. The 50 percent fixture arithmetic was confirmed by running the script (Overall Completion: 50%). Small nits: the -m rationale is misleading and the exit-3 taxonomy claim is about other scripts and not grounded here.
notes.requirements: REQ-001..007 cover exit 3 below N, exit 0 at or above N including N=0, byte-identical text and JSON output, and missing/abc/-1/101 values exiting 1 with ERROR and no report, plus --file mode. All testable.
notes.verification: Every task has a Verify clause and the fixture gives a real boundary (51 exits 3, 50 exits 0) that catches off-by-one and wrong-variable bugs. Some Verify clauses give no full runnable command.
notes.scope: Stays on the one option. Some generic template filler remains in plan.md and the spec metadata.
notes.consistency: spec, plan and tasks agree on exit codes, the 0-100 range, the fixture (2 placeholders over 4 lines = 50%), the boundary matrix, paths and the task count (14).
notes.clarity: Implementable without questions, apart from small gaps: how the gate gets the --file-mode percentage (output_text keeps it local) and how leading-zero values such as 08 are handled.
